findings.passage: Tom has five main emphasis areas as a legislator: Upholding the sanctity of life;  Protecting Second Amendment rights;  Improving election integrity so Pennsylvania voters have trust in our election process.; - Helping parents have a stronger influence in decisions surrounding their children's education and giving parents access to curriculum details in our public schools; and Fighting to keep government spending in check so that taxpayers can keep more of their hard-earned money.
